title: $SAFEMODE
text: Gates the cheat engine so codes only apply after POPS has left the PS1 OSD/BIOS. Recommended as the first line of every CHEATS.TXT. Without it, raw codes that touch the OSD-load region can crash POPS on startup. CHEATS.TXT global or per-game. Engine present since WIP06 OBT01; $SAFEMODE itself was made functional in Beta 12 (2015-11-24). $SAFEMODE safemode

title: $SMOOTH
text: Enables smooth (bilinear) texture mapping at startup. Underlying raw value is '$S0003390 00000001'. Live in-game toggle: Select+L1+R2 = enable, Select+L2+R1 = disable. CHEATS.TXT global or per-game. Added r13 WIP05/WIP06 era. Effect is subtle. $SMOOTH s0003390 smooth

title: $NOPAL
text: Disables POPStarter's automatic PAL patcher (a PAL game then runs in POPS native NTSC). Equivalent to the stock PATCH_9.BIN. Not meant to convert NTSC games to PAL. (Changelog-sourced, not in the wiki: since Beta 13 the PAL patcher auto-disables when GSM's XBRA+GSM magics are in memory, so $NOPAL after launching GSModeSelector is no longer needed.) CHEATS.TXT global or per-game. $NOPAL nopal

title: $FORCEPAL
text: Forces the PAL patcher (POPS runs PAL) AND patches the BIOS region code to Euro (boot screen shows in PAL). For PAL VCDs whose bootsector lacks valid license text. Equivalent to PATCH_8.BIN. CHEATS.TXT global or per-game. Added Beta 12 (2015-11-24). $FORCEPAL forcepal

title: $FAKELC
text: Loads a null LibCrypt magic word into the cop0 register, for discs with messed-up LibCrypt protection. CHEATS.TXT per-game. Added in the r13 WIP06 cheat-engine era. Beta 13 fixed 'the LC fix was flushed and $FAKELC could not set it up'. $FAKELC fakelc

title: $COMPATIBILITY_0x##
text: Activates a POPS compatibility mode at runtime; ## = hex 01-07. Textual equivalent of dropping the matching PATCH_#.BIN. You may write as many lines as you want (subject to the no-combine rule). CHEATS.TXT global or per-game. Fixed (previously broken) in Beta 13 (2015-12-07). $COMPATIBILITY_0x04 compatibility_0x compatibility_0x04

title: $CODECACHE_ADDON_0
text: For games that lag badly or stall randomly when mode 0x04 doesn't help. Most games STOP working with it - use sparingly per-game. CHEATS.TXT per-game. Documented from the 2017-10-28 wiki revision. $CODECACHE_ADDON_0 codecache_addon_0

title: $SUBCDSTATUS
text: A variant of $COMPATIBILITY_0x05 (sub-CD status handling). CHEATS.TXT per-game. Documented from the 2017-10-28 wiki revision. $SUBCDSTATUS compatibility_0x05 subcdstatus

title: $480p
text: Forces 480p output. Marked 'NOT reliable ATM' in the wiki. Hardcode-equivalent: config offset $42A=0x02. CHEATS.TXT per-game. $480p

title: $HDTVFIX
text: Enables a SetGsCrt hack (static interlace param). Helps HDTVs/LED TVs that can't deal with POPS interlaced resolutions over component (otherwise green screens / garbage). Hardcode-equivalent: config offset $412=0x01. CHEATS.TXT per-game. $HDTVFIX hdtvfix

title: $SCANLINES
text: Enables the scanlines generator - draws horizontal raster lines to mimic old CRT TVs/tube monitors. CHEATS.TXT per-game. Present in the 2020-06-26 wiki revision; NOT in the 2017 revisions. $SCANLINES scanlines

title: $XPOS_####
text: Centers/shifts the screen horizontally. #### is DECIMAL (no negatives). Default 640; below 640 moves left, above moves right. CHEATS.TXT per-game. PAL/NTSC modes only. $XPOS_640 xpos_ xpos_640

title: $YPOS_##
text: Centers/shifts the screen vertically. DECIMAL (no negatives). No default - depends on the game; higher moves down. CHEATS.TXT per-game. PAL/NTSC only. Was broken in OBT15, fixed OBT16. $YPOS_20 ypos_ ypos_20

title: $DWSTRETCH_####
text: Stretches the display horizontally. DECIMAL. Default 2559; increase to stretch right, decrease to stretch left. CHEATS.TXT per-game. PAL/NTSC only. $DWSTRETCH_2559 dwstretch_ dwstretch_2559

title: $DWCROP_####
text: Reduces/expands the display area width. DECIMAL. Maximum 2560; decrease to crop on the right. CHEATS.TXT per-game. PAL/NTSC only. $DWCROP_2560 dwcrop_ dwcrop_2560

title: $WIDESCREEN
text: Enables the POPS GTE widescreen hack, forces 16:9. Does NOT fix HUDs, text/fonts, menus or 2D backgrounds (hack unfinished). CHEATS.TXT per-game. Documented from 2017-10-28 wiki revision. $WIDESCREEN widescreen

title: $ULTRA_WIDESCREEN
text: As $WIDESCREEN but wider FOV (matches no standard aspect ratio). No HUD/text/menu fix. CHEATS.TXT per-game. $ULTRA_WIDESCREEN ultra_widescreen widescreen

title: $EYEFINITY
text: As $WIDESCREEN but 3x16:9 (triple-wide). No HUD/text/menu fix. CHEATS.TXT per-game. $EYEFINITY eyefinity widescreen

title: $MUTE_CDDA
text: Mutes CDDA (Red Book) tracks. Done automatically when playing a physical PS1 CD-ROM. CHEATS.TXT per-game. From 2017-10-28 wiki revision. $MUTE_CDDA mute_cdda

title: $UNDO_MUTE_CDDA
text: Unmutes CDDA tracks in PS1CD mode (overrides the automatic mute when reading a physical disc). CHEATS.TXT per-game, PS1CD mode. $UNDO_MUTE_CDDA undo_mute_cdda

title: $MUTE_VAB
text: Mutes VAB/VAG/VB+VH-based sound/music. For old games with distorted SFX, wrong samples or noise. CHEATS.TXT per-game. $MUTE_VAB mute_vab

title: $D2LS
text: 'Left Stick is the D-Pad' code + stay on Digital mode. Enables analog-stick support for games that don't support it natively. Recommended default; try $D2LS_ALT if it fails. CHEATS.TXT per-game. Dedicated D2LS wiki page exists. $D2LS d2ls d2ls_alt

title: $D2LS_ALT
text: 'Left Stick is the D-Pad' code + stay on Analog mode. Alternative when the digital-mode variant fails. CHEATS.TXT per-game. $D2LS_ALT d2ls_alt

title: $NOVMC0
text: Use VMC1 only (do not mount VMC0, the first virtual memory card). Hardcode-equivalent partial: config offset $429. CHEATS.TXT per-game. From 2017-10-28 wiki revision. $NOVMC0 novmc0

title: $NOVMC1
text: Use VMC0 only (do not mount VMC1, the second virtual memory card). CHEATS.TXT per-game. $NOVMC1 novmc1

title: $CACHE1
text: Makes POPS buffer 1 sector instead of the default 16. CHEATS.TXT per-game. Added r13 WIP05/06 era. $CACHE1 cache1

title: $USBDELAY_#
text: Sets the PFS-wrapper USB delay applied inside POPS (# = a number); smooths streaming on slow USB devices. NOTE: this patches POPS, NOT POPStarter - it does NOT fix 'USB drive not detected' (use config offset $413 for that). CHEATS.TXT per-game/global. Added r13 WIP05/06 era. $USBDELAY_5 usbdelay_ usbdelay_5

title: $UNDO_GAME_FIXES
text: Prevents POPStarter from applying its built-in per-game fixes (re-exposes original bugs). Some fixes became obsolete via later POPS patches, so it may not re-expose every problem (e.g. Crash Bandicoot PAL now works without its fix). CHEATS.TXT per-game. Present in the 2020-06-26 wiki revision. $UNDO_GAME_FIXES undo_game_fixes

title: Raw GameShark/AR code line ($<addr> <val>)
text: Any line starting with $ followed by address, a space, then value is applied as a raw cheat. PS1 RAW types 30/50/80/D0 (GameShark/Action Replay) supported; PS2 RAW types 0/1/2 supported. CHEATS.TXT in the game's VMC folder (per-game) or in the POPS root (ALL games). Engine present since WIP06 OBT01. $800AC402 0800

title: C0 master code
text: Some PS1 games require a master/enable code or they crash (e.g. Air Race Championship). ONLY type C0 master codes are supported; type C1 (activation-on-delay-time) are not and 'will not be' supported. CHEATS.TXT per-game. Beta 13 fixed an 'incorrect load instruction for $C0' bug and a $USBDELAY/$C0 coexistence bug. $C00AB840 1234 c0 c00ab840 usbdelay

title: PS1->PS2 RAW conversion / external mastercode
text: To convert a PS1 code to PS2 RAW, add 01000000 to the address and follow the target engine's code-type rules. The POPS mastercode for EXTERNAL PS2 cheat devices (ps2rd/CodeBreaker) is 902377F4 0C0902EF - NOT needed when using CHEATS.TXT. Applies when porting external PS1 cheat lists or using a hardware/software PS2 cheat device. 902377F4 0C0902EF

title: Rumble Always On raw codes
text: $00507028 00000001 = Pad 1 rumble always on; $005070B8 00000001 = Pad 2 rumble always on. Pre-listed example raw codes. CHEATS.TXT per-game. $00507028 00000001

title: LibCrypt example block (Jackie Chan Stuntmaster PAL)
text: A complete real LibCrypt fix code block to use when the built-in crack and $FAKELC both fail: $20210CF8 2442FFFF / $20210CFC 7C640000 / $20210D00 00000000 / $20210D04 00000000 / $20210D08 00000000 / $00210D0C 000000FA / $S200009C 1F000000. CHEATS.TXT per-game (Jackie Chan Stuntmaster PAL, also see SCES-01444 entry). $20210CF8 2442FFFF (first line of the block) fakelc s200009c

title: PATCH_1.BIN (mode 0x01)
text: 'Helps restoring the music/voices in several games.' Drop in game VMC dir (one game) or POPS dir (all games). r13. Drop PATCH_1.BIN, or put $COMPATIBILITY_0x01 in CHEATS.TXT compatibility_0x01

title: PATCH_2.BIN (mode 0x02)
text: Variant of mode 0x01 with a second hack to not break MDECoding of FMVs (designed for the Colony Wars series). Game VMC dir or POPS dir. r13. $COMPATIBILITY_0x02 compatibility_0x02

title: PATCH_3.BIN (mode 0x03)
text: Alternate to mode 0x01 - use when 0x01 doesn't give the expected results. Game VMC dir or POPS dir. r13. $COMPATIBILITY_0x03 compatibility_0x03

title: PATCH_4.BIN (mode 0x04)
text: Fixes slowdowns, flickering and many glitches (prevents the emulator writing a garbage value into two virtual GPU registers). Game VMC dir or POPS dir. r13. $COMPATIBILITY_0x01 + $COMPATIBILITY_0x04 (allowed combo) compatibility_0x01 compatibility_0x04

title: PATCH_5.BIN (mode 0x05)
text: Fixes the cutscenes of PAL Resident Evil: Director's Cut. Still shipped as PATCH_5.BIN. Game VMC dir or POPS dir. r13. $COMPATIBILITY_0x05 compatibility_0x05

title: PATCH_6.BIN (mode 0x06)
text: Disables the OSD shell of the emulator's built-in BIOS, making some games that freeze on startup run. Game VMC dir or POPS dir. r13. $COMPATIBILITY_0x06 compatibility_0x06

title: Mode 0x07 ($COMPATIBILITY_0x07)
text: Fixes missing-textures problems (example: Tomb Raider III). This mode IS documented in the recovered wiki compatibility table (it is not new/undocumented). Wiki caveat: "Unfinished (breaks the gamma)"; the 2024 wiki snapshot marks this mode obsolete. No documented stock PATCH_7.BIN ships it. r13. Via $COMPATIBILITY_0x07 in CHEATS.TXT. $COMPATIBILITY_0x07 compatibility_0x07

title: No-combine rule (modes 0x01/0x02/0x03/0x05)
text: 'Modes 0x01, 0x02, 0x03 and 0x05 cannot be combined - variants of the same hack, conflicting; use only one at a time.' These four poke CD status; 0x04/0x06/0x07 are independent and combinable. All compatibility-mode entry points (PATCH file, CHEATS.TXT, hardcoded $418-$41F). r13. OK: 0x01+0x04. WRONG: 0x01+0x02

title: PATCH_7.BIN
text: UNDOCUMENTED / AMBIGUOUS. Absent from the surviving wiki, r13 changelog, IGR download table, and the community manual (which jumps PATCH_6 -> PATCH_8). Older (2014 krHACKen, ASSEMblergames) lore says it forced mode 0x06; later mirrors call 'Mode 7' obsolete. No primary file recovered. DISTINCT from the verified TROJAN_7.BIN game-fix bundle. Unknown / legacy. NOT in r13 stock asset set. (none - existence unconfirmed)

title: PATCH_8.BIN (PAL / $FORCEPAL)
text: Forces PAL output: activates the PAL patcher AND patches the BIOS region code to Euro (boot screen in PAL). For PAL VCDs with no/broken license text. Equivalent to $FORCEPAL. Game VMC dir or POPS dir, or use $FORCEPAL. r13. $FORCEPAL (or drop PATCH_8.BIN) forcepal

title: PATCH_9.BIN (STOCK = $NOPAL)
text: The long-standing stock file. Disables POPStarter's automatic PAL patcher so a PAL game runs in POPS native NTSC video. Equivalent to $NOPAL. Wiki: 'PATCH_9.BIN now obsolete (still working tho)' because GSM v0.23x auto-detection later made it usually unnecessary. Game VMC dir or POPS dir. r13. $NOPAL (or drop stock PATCH_9.BIN to run a PAL VCD in NTSC) nopal

title: PATCH_9.BIN (2020 IGR-loader-disable / return-to-OPL)
text: A SEPARATE krHACKen file released 2020-03-21 that REUSES the name PATCH_9.BIN. Disables POPStarter's bugged ELF loader (the Beta-13 BOOT.ELF launcher) so IGR/quit falls back to OSDSYS/Browser; with FMCB's button action repointed to OPNPS2LD.ELF, IGR then chains into OPL. Restores 'IGR back to OPL' which BETA-13 broke. Drop in POPS dir (mass0:/POPS/, hdd __common/POPS, SMB share/POPS). Requires FMCB. r13 + BETA13 era. PATCH_9.7z MD5 9db1e18bae92c4991e3de7e2a752558c (188 bytes). mass0:/POPS/PATCH_9.BIN (the 2020 return-to-OPL build) + FMCB Configurator -> OSDSYS action = mc1:/OPL/OPNPS2LD.ELF

title: PATCH_0.BIN
text: Disables the IGR menu. Equivalent to $NOIGR. An IGR behaviour modifier shipped as a PATCH file. MD5 PATCH_0.zip b8d32e32d9d27c58e6558f9ad538f555 (221 bytes). Game VMC dir or POPS dir. r13. Copy PATCH_0.BIN to POPS dir to kill the IGR menu globally (or $NOIGR) noigr

title: PATCH/TROJAN header-number integrity check
text: POPStarter validates that the NUMBER in a PATCH/TROJAN filename matches a number stored in the file's header (TROJAN build-ID at offset Ah, version at offset Ch=0x03). It refuses to load the file if they don't match; stale-version files auto-skip. To reuse a slot, rename AND hex-edit the header number. All PATCH_#.BIN and TROJAN_#.BIN, both VMC-dir and POPS-dir. r13. To run two copies: rename PATCH_1.BIN -> PATCH_3.BIN AND hex-edit the embedded '1' -> '3' in its header

title: PPF bunch pack (on-load patches)
text: A set of .PPF patches (apply over POPSTARTER.ELF with PPF-O-Matic) that toggle config-table bytes without hex editing: NO_LC_CRACKS.PPF, DEBUG_AND_HALT.PPF ($410+$411), NO_VMC.PPF ($429=01), ONLY_1ST_VMC.PPF ($429=02), NO_PAL.PPF ($42A=00), FORCE_MODEX.PPF ($418-$41F), DEFAULT_IGR_TEXTURES.PPF ($42D=00), LC_ONLY.PPF ($42F=02), NO_AUTO_PATCH.PPF ($42F=00). Applied to POPSTARTER.ELF/.KELF, r13. Apply DEBUG_AND_HALT.PPF to turn on the diagnostic screen instead of hand-editing $410/$411

title: TROJAN file - DEFINITION
text: In POPStarter a 'TROJAN' is NOT malware - it is krHACKen's NAME for a binary patch asset (TROJAN_#.BIN) loaded from the game's VMC folder or the POPS folder. Serves TWO roles: (1) IGR BEHAVIOUR MODIFIERS (TROJAN_0..5 = alternate IGR combo/quit method, TROJAN_9 = no-2nd-pad-in-IGR); (2) GAME FIXES (per-game-ID AntiCrash/LoadinFix/Boot Fix/SkipVSync/Skip-CutScenes from the 'game fixes archive', bundled cumulatively e.g. TROJAN_7). Differs from PATCH_#.BIN (forces compatibility modes / disables IGR) and CHEATS.TXT (plain-text $commands + raw codes). Game VMC dir (one game) or POPS dir (all games). r13. Obeys the header-number integrity check. Game fix: copy a 'WipEout AntiCrash' TROJAN into the WipEout VMC dir. IGR mod: copy TROJAN_1.BIN for a Start+Select reset combo. commands

title: TROJAN_0.BIN
text: IGR behaviour modifier - OPENS the IGR menu on a 6-button combo. CHEATS.TXT equivalent: $IGR0 (L1+L2+R1+R2+X+Down). MD5 TROJAN_0.zip 9c431cb92e72d38dcd015d2d1840e3c5 (246B). Game VMC dir or POPS dir. r13. $IGR0 (equivalent to dropping TROJAN_0.BIN) igr0

title: TROJAN_1.BIN
text: IGR behaviour modifier - OPENS the IGR menu on Start+Select. CHEATS.TXT equivalent: $IGR1. MD5 d5551d731a0eae6745e894d8a1b823ed (248B). Game VMC dir or POPS dir. r13. $IGR1 igr1

title: TROJAN_2.BIN
text: IGR behaviour modifier - OPENS the IGR menu on L1+L2+R1+R2+Start+Select. CHEATS.TXT equivalent: $IGR2. MD5 5a5e519f2f396eb5323719a659790bee (245B). Game VMC dir or POPS dir. r13. $IGR2 igr2

title: TROJAN_3.BIN
text: IGR behaviour modifier - TERMINATES POPS (no menu) on L1+L2+R1+R2+X+Down. CHEATS.TXT equivalent: $IGR3. MD5 c85f0e2a9ef4e4ea35ab1462493c6a2d (263B). Game VMC dir or POPS dir. r13. $IGR3 igr3

title: TROJAN_4.BIN
text: IGR behaviour modifier - TERMINATES POPS (no menu) on Start+Select. CHEATS.TXT equivalent: $IGR4. MD5 8ac51ec7e36e1bf06f6ddd1f072b2c9f (262B). Game VMC dir or POPS dir. r13. $IGR4 igr4

title: TROJAN_5.BIN
text: IGR behaviour modifier - TERMINATES POPS (no menu) on L1+L2+R1+R2+Start+Select (the OPL-style no-popup combo). CHEATS.TXT equivalent: $IGR5. MD5 fb0ee2841ca3c40f2483ac4c00c4594c (260B). Game VMC dir or POPS dir. r13. $IGR5 igr5

title: TROJAN_7.BIN
text: GAME-FIX BUNDLE (not an IGR modifier). 'Cumulative r6, fixes as of 2020/05/20' - a cumulative pack of per-game crash/compat fixes; released 2020-08-13. MD5 TROJAN_7.zip e5e150f8be4da1fa822b90cb9682cf8e (775B - notably larger than the IGR TROJANs). Game VMC dir or POPS dir. 2020-era r13. Drop TROJAN_7.BIN in POPS dir to apply the 2020-05-20 cumulative game fixes

title: TROJAN_9.BIN
text: IGR behaviour modifier variant - 'No 2nd Pad in IGR' (ignores controller port 2 input in the IGR menu so a 2nd pad can't trigger/navigate it). MD5 TROJAN_9.zip b6960e9a26034723eeea0ebcbe114334 (250B). Game VMC dir or POPS dir. r13. Drop TROJAN_9.BIN to stop pad-2 from opening the IGR menu

title: $IGR0
text: Hold L1+L2+R1+R2+X+Down to OPEN the IGR menu. CHEATS.TXT command, integrated 2016/11/20 WIP06 Beta 16. Standalone equivalent: TROJAN_0.BIN. $IGR0 igr0

title: $IGR1
text: Hold Start+Select to OPEN the IGR menu. CHEATS.TXT command (Beta 16, 2016/11/20). Standalone equivalent: TROJAN_1.BIN. $IGR1 igr1

title: $IGR2
text: Hold L1+L2+R1+R2+Start+Select to OPEN the IGR menu. CHEATS.TXT command (Beta 16, 2016/11/20). Standalone equivalent: TROJAN_2.BIN. $IGR2 igr2

title: $IGR3
text: Hold L1+L2+R1+R2+X+Down to TERMINATE POPS directly (no menu). On quit POPStarter then tries mc0:/BOOT/BOOT.ELF, then mc1:/BOOT/BOOT.ELF, else Browser/OSDSYS. CHEATS.TXT command (Beta 16, 2016/11/20). Standalone equivalent: TROJAN_3.BIN. $IGR3 igr3

title: $IGR4
text: Hold Start+Select to TERMINATE POPS directly (no menu). CHEATS.TXT command (Beta 16, 2016/11/20). Standalone equivalent: TROJAN_4.BIN. $IGR4 igr4

title: $IGR5
text: Hold L1+L2+R1+R2+Start+Select to TERMINATE POPS directly (no menu) - the OPL-style no-popup exit macro. Was broken in earlier r13 builds and FIXED in the final 2019/06/05 build. CHEATS.TXT command (Beta 16, 2016/11/20; fixed 2019/06/05). Standalone equivalent: TROJAN_5.BIN. $IGR5 igr5

title: $NOIGR
text: Disables the IGR menu entirely (no in-game-reset trigger). Means the only exit is whatever the game itself or a hard reset provides. CHEATS.TXT command. Standalone equivalent: PATCH_0.BIN. $NOIGR noigr

title: Default IGR trigger (no modifier)
text: With no $IGR#/TROJAN set, the default combo (community-reported L1+Select+Start) opens POPStarter's IGR menu - a Japanese-language reset/return prompt. The IGR 'skin' is enabled by default in the config table. All r13 betas. Menu text is Japanese unless a translated IGR texture is installed. In-game hold L1+Select+Start -> IGR menu -> YES -> confirm igr

title: BOOT.ELF exit chain
text: On IGR quit AND on POPStarter quit-on-failure, the launcher tries mc0:/BOOT/BOOT.ELF, then mc1:/BOOT/BOOT.ELF; if not found/invalid it exits to the PS2 Browser (OSDSYS, which runs FMCB/FHDB if installed). Added 2015/12/07 WIP06 Beta 13. mc0 before mc1. Global, all storage modes; Beta 13 -> r13 final. Gated by config $424=0x01 (the r13 IGR exit method). Put your launcher at mc0:/BOOT/BOOT.ELF so IGR-quit returns there

title: No documented BOOT.ELF path override
text: There is NO config/command to redirect the exit chain away from mc0/mc1:/BOOT/BOOT.ELF - the path is hard-coded. A user (Jay-Jay) publicly asked krHACKen for an override on 2016-11-28; it was never implemented through r13. All r13 builds through 2019/06/05. Want IGR to land in uLaunchELF? Name uLaunchELF itself BOOT.ELF at mc0:/BOOT/BOOT.ELF

title: Quit-on-failure uses the same BOOT.ELF chain
text: POPStarter's quit-on-failure code (when POPStarter, not POPS, bails) runs the SAME mc0/mc1:/BOOT/BOOT.ELF -> Browser chain as IGR exit. Added together in Beta 13. Since 2015/12/07 Beta 13. (automatic)

title: Untested PS1 software-reset hotkey (Select+L2+R2+X)
text: An additional, explicitly-untested PS1 software reset combo added alongside the IGR-modifier integration. Note the same combo was earlier a speed-up/FPS-boost hotkey (combo reuse across builds). Added ~Beta 16. Marked untested by the author. Select+L2+R2+X

title: Config table location/size
text: The POPStarter r13 ELF and KELF contain a 32-byte configuration table from file offset $410 (1040 dec) through $42F, one byte per setting. Verified default table: 00 00 00 02 40 00 03 01 | 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 | 01 00 01 01 01 01 01 01 | 01 00 01 01 01 01 01 03. ELF (167700B) and KELF (167708B) tables are byte-identical. There is NO offset above $42F. POPSTARTER.ELF/.KELF, r13. Patch via hex edit or the PPF bunch pack. $410..$42F = 00 00 00 02 40 00 03 01 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 01 00 01 01 01 01 01 01 01 00 01 01 01 01 01 03

title: $410 - debug text display
text: 0x00 = debug printing DISABLED (factory default, the 'classic' build). 0x01-0xFE = delay between debug pages (higher = longer; ~0x12/18 dec readable). 0xFF = realtime debug text (POPStarter 12 behavior). Basis of the community 'classic 00 vs debug FF' label. POPSTARTER.ELF/.KELF byte $410. r13. SMB-mode setups effectively run debug-on. Set byte $410 to 12 (=18 dec) for paced debug pages, or FF for realtime

title: $411 - break/halt on error
text: 0x00 = print the error briefly then kick to PS2 OSD (default). Non-zero = print the error and sleep on that screen indefinitely (so you can read it). POPSTARTER.ELF/.KELF byte $411. r13. Default 0x00. Set $411=0x01 to freeze on the error/debug screen when a game fails to boot

title: $412 - SetGsCrt / HDTVFIX hack
text: 0x00 = disabled (default). 0x01 = enabled. The feature exposed as the $HDTVFIX cheat. CORRECTION to base report: in r13 $412 is HDTVFIX, NOT a 'function skipper'. The function skipper lived at $412 ONLY in pre-Beta-13 builds and was REMOVED in WIP06 Beta 13 (2015-12-07, ~10KB saved); the freed byte was repurposed for SetGsCrt in Beta 15/16 (2016). POPSTARTER.ELF/.KELF byte $412. r13. Default 0x00. SetGsCrt implemented Beta 15, default-off Beta 16. $HDTVFIX, or hex-edit byte $412=0x01, to fix green-screen on a component HDTV hdtvfix

title: $413 - USB access delay
text: USB access delay applied AFTER POPStarter's embedded USB modules run (how long it waits before reaching the USB device). Default 0x02. Increase if POPStarter fails to access the USB device. POPSTARTER.ELF/.KELF byte $413. r13. USB mode. Default 0x02 (verified). USB drive not detected: hex-edit byte $413 from 02 up to 05/0A until it mounts

title: $414 - RESERVED
text: RESERVED (in USB operation mode). Must be 0x40. Not a user tunable. POPSTARTER.ELF/.KELF byte $414. r13. Default 0x40. (leave at 0x40)

title: $415 - per-VMC user ID
text: User ID for individual VMCs. 0x00 = disabled (default). Set to the ASCII code of a digit '0'..'9' (0x30..0x39) to tag the VMC pair to a user (lets multiple users keep separate VMCs from one install). POPSTARTER.ELF/.KELF byte $415. r13. Default 0x00. Set $415=0x32 (ASCII '2') so this build uses VMCs tagged for user 2

title: $416 - POPS dev9 module loading
text: POPS dev9 module loading (USB mode). 0x00 = let POPS load dev9. 0x03 = forbid loading (default). Set 0x00 to wake the NIC (e.g. for debugging). POPSTARTER.ELF/.KELF byte $416. r13. Default 0x03. (default 0x03 keeps NIC off during USB play)

title: $417 - NOT USED (legacy PFS-wrapper USB delay)
text: Marked 'NOT USED' in the r13 wiki (vestigial; shipped byte reads 0x01). HISTORICALLY this was the PFS-wrapper USB delay (default 0x05 in Beta 2 2015-06-25, changed to 0x00 in Beta 8 2015-10-23). Old guides citing 'USB delay at 417h' refer to this obsolete PFS-wrapper delay; in r13 use $413. POPSTARTER.ELF/.KELF byte $417. r13 = NOT USED; 2015 betas = PFS-wrapper delay. (do not edit; use $413 instead)

title: $418-$41F - force compatibility modes (8 slots)
text: Force a single compatibility mode per byte; 8 slots = force up to 8 modes simultaneously. Per byte: 0x00 = no mode; 0x0X = force that mode AND disable the automatic activator. All default 0x00. The 8-slot design was added WIP02 (2014-08-22). POPSTARTER.ELF/.KELF bytes $418-$41F. r13. Hardcode mode 0x04 + 0x06 globally: $418=0x04, $419=0x06 (rest 0x00)

title: $420 - patch the genuine HDD check
text: 0x00 = don't patch. 0x01 = patch (default). Effectively a no-op for end users (homebrew ATAD on PS2, original POPS ATAD on PSX). krHACKen: 'totally useless, leave it to 0x01.' POPSTARTER.ELF/.KELF byte $420. r13. Default 0x01. (leave at 0x01)

title: $421 - load/execute POPS BIOS OSD shell
text: 0x00 = load into user memory and execute (default; don't patch). 0x01 = don't load/execute - same effect as compatibility mode 0x06 (skips CD checks and the PS logo). Neither value applies if a user BIOS.BIN is supplied. POPSTARTER.ELF/.KELF byte $421. r13. Default 0x00. Set $421=0x01 to globally skip the BIOS OSD shell / PS logo (same as mode 6)

title: $422 - exception breakpoints
text: 0x00 = break the emulator. 0x01 = NOP the 2nd-stage exception handler's break instructions, allowing IGR after the emulation has crashed (in a few cases). Shipped default 0x01. POPSTARTER.ELF/.KELF byte $422. r13. Default 0x01. (default 0x01 lets you IGR out of a crashed emulator)

title: $423 - SLBB-00001 disc0 integrity check
text: Original SLBB-00001 disc0 integrity-check control. 0x00 = don't skip. 0x01 = skip (default). Relates to the PSX/PSBBN SLBB-00001 boot disc path. POPSTARTER.ELF/.KELF byte $423. r13. Default 0x01. (default 0x01)

title: $424 - IGR exit method
text: 0x00 = original SLBB-00001+PSBBN method (reads MBR itself, no cache flush, no IOP reset - crashy for most users). 0x01 = POPStarter r13 method (default), which enables the mc0->mc1:/BOOT/BOOT.ELF->OSDSYS exit chain from Beta 13. POPSTARTER.ELF/.KELF byte $424. r13. Default 0x01. (default 0x01 enables the BOOT.ELF exit chain)

title: $425 - IOPCD stack size patch
text: IOPCD stack size patch (USB mode). 0x00 = don't patch. 0x01 = patch (default). POPSTARTER.ELF/.KELF byte $425. r13. Default 0x01. USB mode. (default 0x01)

title: $426 - Delcro's patches
text: Delcro's patches (USB mode). 0x00 = don't apply to POPS. 0x01 = apply (default). POPSTARTER.ELF/.KELF byte $426. r13. Default 0x01. USB mode. (default 0x01)

title: $427 - emulator-modules load-failure behavior
text: 0x00 = don't patch (kick to PS2 OSD). 0x01 = patch: ignore the returned code of an injected IRX and continue (default). 'For your h4x0ring needz.' POPSTARTER.ELF/.KELF byte $427. r13. Default 0x01. (default 0x01)

title: $428 - internal-HDD init-failure behavior
text: 0x00 = don't patch (kick to PS2 OSD). 0x01 = patch: ignore and continue (default). 'For your h4x0ring needz.' POPSTARTER.ELF/.KELF byte $428. r13. Default 0x01. (default 0x01)

title: $429 - Virtual Memory Cards control
text: 0x00 = use both VMCs (default). 0x01 = don't use VMCs at all. 0x02 = use only the first VMC in the first virtual slot. This (NOT $42A) controls how many VMCs are created. Hardcoded equivalent of $NOVMC0/$NOVMC1. POPSTARTER.ELF/.KELF byte $429. r13. Default 0x00. Disable all VMCs globally: $429=0x01 (or NO_VMC.PPF) novmc0 novmc1

title: $42A - auto-PAL patch / 480p
text: 0x00 = disabled (PAL patcher off, = $NOPAL). 0x01 = enabled (auto-PAL when 'Euro' is found at VCD offset $102514; default). 0x02 = FORCE 480p output. 480p calc added Beta 15 (2016-09-18). POPSTARTER.ELF/.KELF byte $42A. r13. Default 0x01. Force 480p: byte $42A=0x02 (or $480p). Disable PAL patcher: $42A=0x00 (or $NOPAL) nopal

title: $42B - resident modules loader
text: 0x00 = disabled. 0x01 = enabled (default). Loads POPS/MODULE_0.IRX .. MODULE_9.IRX AFTER the IOP is reset with IOPRP252.IMG (kills matching embedded POPS drivers). POPSTARTER.ELF/.KELF byte $42B. r13. Default 0x01. (default 0x01)

title: $42C - software PowerOff fix
text: 0x00 = disabled. 0x01 = enabled (default). Purpose uncertain even to the author ('can't remember... perhaps redundant... Prolific, mass?'). POPSTARTER.ELF/.KELF byte $42C. r13. Default 0x01. (default 0x01)

title: $42D - IGR textures loader
text: 0x00 = disabled. 0x01 = enabled (default). Loads POPS/IGR_BG.TM2, IGR_NO.TM2, IGR_YES.TM2 for the IGR menu skin. POPSTARTER.ELF/.KELF byte $42D. r13. Default 0x01. (default 0x01)

title: $42E - game license/region check
text: 0x00 = leave unpatched. 0x01 = patch so the BIOS doesn't loop the region check when the VCD isn't NTSC-J (default; NOPs the loop). The PS logo is not shown for non-JAP games. POPSTARTER.ELF/.KELF byte $42E. r13. Default 0x01. (default 0x01)

title: $42F - automatic compatibility-mode activator (master switch)
text: 0x00 = enable nothing. 0x01 = automatic compatibility-mode activation. 0x02 = other subroutines (LibCrypt cracks). 0x03 = ALL (default). 0x04 = 'test mode' (disables per-game fixes, automated modes and LibCrypt fixes; enables integrated test-hacks; added WIP06 Prototype 2 2017-05-27). Special: if 0x03 AND a mode is forced in $418-$41F, it auto-changes to 0x02. POPSTARTER.ELF/.KELF byte $42F (last byte). r13. Default 0x03. Disable all auto-patching: $42F=0x00 (NO_AUTO_PATCH.PPF). LibCrypt-only: $42F=0x02 (LC_ONLY.PPF)

title: 'classic 00 vs debug FF' build label
text: Community shorthand for the two states of config byte $410: 'classic' ships $410=0x00 (silent boot), 'debug' is $410=0xFF (realtime debug text, old POPStarter-12 behavior). NOT a separate codebase - same ELF, one byte differs (plus optionally $411). POPSTARTER.ELF/.KELF byte $410. Canonical r13 download ships 'classic' (00). 'Classic': $410=00. 'Debug realtime': $410=FF. 'Debug paced': $410=12 (18 dec)

title: USB layout: mass:/POPS/ (root POPS folder)
text: USB storage. POPS folder must be at the ROOT of the USB device; contains POPS_IOX.PAK (emulator), the VCDs, and the renamed launcher ELFs. Device must be FAT12/16/32 (NOT NTFS) and DEFRAGMENTED. USB mass storage. USB launch type introduced WIP02. POPS/POPS_IOX.PAK ; POPS/Crash Bandicoot.VCD ; XX.Crash Bandicoot.elf

title: USB scan order: POPS, POPS0..POPS9
text: POPStarter looks for the named VCD in POPS or POPS0..POPS9 at USB root (split a large library across folders). POPS_IOX.PAK + the TM2 textures stay in the MAIN POPS folder; BIOS.BIN/PATCH_#.BIN/TROJAN_#.BIN/VMCDIR.TXT must be COPIED into every POPS# folder. USB mode. POPS#-folder feature introduced r13 WIP06 OBT; reading VCDs from POPS# bugfixed Beta 11 (2015-11-11). POPS0/Tekken.VCD launched by XX.Tekken.elf; copy VMCDIR.TXT into each POPS# folder

title: USB launcher ELF naming: XX.<name>.elf
text: Rename the POPStarter ELF to the VCD's name, swap .VCD for .elf, add the 'XX.' prefix (third char is a literal dot). Prefix and the .VCD extension must be UPPERCASE. USB supports ONLY this 'new' launch type. USB mode only. VCD 'Gran Turismo.VCD' -> ELF 'XX.Gran Turismo.elf'

title: USB/network modules: mc0:/POPSTARTER/ then mc1:/POPSTARTER/
text: POPStarter loads usbd.irx/usbhdfsd.irx (and network modules) from the MC POPSTARTER folder, slot 0 first, falling back to mc1 when a file is missing. Loading modules from 'mass' is NO longer supported. PFS_WRAP.BIN no longer needed since OBT8 (embedded into the ELF). USB mode, beta 8+; mc1 fallback added Beta 9 (2015-10-24). mc0:/POPSTARTER/usbd.irx ; mc0:/POPSTARTER/usbhdfsd.irx

title: SMB layout: smb0:/<Share>/POPS/
text: SMB/network storage. Create a POPS directory at the SHARE ROOT (not a subdir); put POPS_IOX.PAK (same file as USB, MD5 a625d0b3036823cdbf04a3c0e1648901, MANDATORY) and the VCDs there. Requires a PS2 NIC + cable + MC. SMB mode. Backend added Beta 8 (2015-10-23); SB. launch type r13 WIP06/OBT08. smb0:/My Shared Folder/POPS/POPS_IOX.PAK ; smb0:/My Shared Folder/POPS/Crash Bandicoot.VCD

title: SMB launcher ELF naming: SB.<name>.elf
text: Rename POPStarter ELF to the VCD name, .VCD -> .elf, add the 'SB.' prefix (third char a literal dot). Uppercase prefix + uppercase .VCD. The ELF can live anywhere you launch from; only the VCD must be in the SMB POPS folder. SMB mode only. Launch type r13 WIP06 OBT08. VCD 'Crash Bandicoot.VCD' -> ELF 'SB.Crash Bandicoot.elf'

title: SMB modules folder: mc#:/POPSTARTER/
text: The PS2-side network modules + the two .DAT config files live in mc0:/POPSTARTER/ (falls back to mc1). Module set: poweroff.irx, ps2dev9.irx, smsutils.irx, ps2ip.irx, ps2smap.irx, smbman.irx, plus IPCONFIG.DAT, SMBCONFIG.DAT. SMB mode. mc1 fallback added Beta 9 (2015-10-24). mc0:/POPSTARTER/SMBCONFIG.DAT ; mc0:/POPSTARTER/IPCONFIG.DAT ; mc0:/POPSTARTER/smbman.irx

title: SMBCONFIG.DAT syntax
text: Line 1: '<SERVER IP> <SHARE NAME>' (optional ':PORT' on the IP, default 445, e.g. ':139'). Line 2 = username, Line 3 = plain-text password for authenticated shares; leave lines 2 and 3 EMPTY for guest access. SMB mode. Port selection added Beta 11 (2015-11-11); authentication added Beta 12 (2015-11-24). 192.168.0.254 My Shared Folder / MyName / MyPassword (or '192.168.0.254:139 My Shared Folder' + empty lines 2-3 for guest)

title: IPCONFIG.DAT syntax (optional)
text: Single line: '<PS2 IP> <NETMASK> <GATEWAY>'. OPTIONAL (DHCP/auto otherwise). Only needed for a static PS2 IP. SMB mode. Made optional in Beta 11 (2015-11-11). 192.168.0.13 255.255.255.0 192.168.0.254

title: REFUTED: 'debug build required for SMB'
text: FALSE. SMB was added as a STANDARD feature in Beta 8 (2015-10-23): 'Added support for ps2host, napLink and SMB (NOT password protected, fixed port 445) shares' - no debug gating. The only debug-related caveat is the wiki note 'Debug infos at startup can NOT be skipped in SMB mode' (cosmetic startup print, NOT a build requirement). SMB mode, Beta 8 onward. Beta 8 line: 'Added support for ... SMB (NOT password protected, fixed port 445) shares'

title: Windows host SMB share setup
text: To serve POPS over SMB from modern Windows: enable 'SMB 1.0/CIFS File Sharing Support', turn OFF 'Password protected sharing', grant Guest/Everyone Read/Write on the share. POPStarter's SMB client is legacy (SMB1, guest, port 445). Host-side (Windows 10/11) for SMB mode. COMMUNITY guidance - not in the official wiki. Windows feature 'SMB 1.0/CIFS File Sharing Support' ON; 'Password protected sharing' OFF; share POPS folder Guest=RW

title: pops-smb-config (on-console SMB editor)
text: A PS2 homebrew tool to edit POPStarter's SMBCONFIG.DAT/IPCONFIG.DAT on the console itself (no PC). Confirms the 3-line SMBCONFIG.DAT format. Companion utility for SMB mode. Edits mc0:/POPSTARTER/SMBCONFIG.DAT in-place on the PS2

title: HDD layout: __.POPS / __.POPS0..9 + __common/POPS (NEW launch type)
text: Internal HDD, modern multi-VCD type. VCDs go in PS2-formatted partition __.POPS (or __.POPS0..__.POPS9). Emulator (decrypted POPS.ELF + IOPRP252.IMG) goes in a POPS folder inside the __common partition. NO prefix on the launcher ELF (named <game>.elf for <game>.VCD). Internal HDD. New launch type introduced POPStarter 13 WIP01. __common/POPS/IOPRP252.IMG ; __common/POPS/POPS.ELF ; __.POPS/Crash Bandicoot.VCD ; __sysconf/FMCB/Crash Bandicoot.elf

title: HDD legacy OLD type: PP.<game> partition (HDDOSD-visible)
text: One VCD per partition named PP.<game>; the VCD is always IMAGE0.VCD (uppercase); launcher prefix PP. (KELF EXECUTE.KELF for HDDOSD). The only type SHOWN in HDDOSD/PSBBN/PSX XMB. POPStarter 12 and older; still supported. Internal HDD, legacy. PP.Crash_Bandicoot/EXECUTE.KELF ; PP.Crash_Bandicoot/IMAGE0.VCD

title: HDD legacy ALTERNATE type: __.<game> partition (hidden)
text: One VCD per partition named __.<game>; VCD is IMAGE0.VCD (uppercase); launcher prefix __. ; partition is HIDDEN (not shown in HDDOSD/PSBBN/XMB). POPStarter 12 and older. Internal HDD, legacy; not HDDOSD-compatible. __.Crash_Bandicoot/IMAGE0.VCD ; __sysconf/FMCB/__.Crash Bandicoot.elf

title: POPSTARTER.KELF (HDDOSD / Sony Browser 2.00)
text: The bundle ships POPSTARTER.KELF (Krypto-ELF, ELF in a Sony container) for when Sony Browser 2.00 (HDDOSD) is installed; otherwise useless. Partition prefix PP.; 1 partition = 1 game (unless multi-disc). Internal HDD with HDDOSD/Browser 2.00 only. POPSTARTER.KELF placed per PP.<game> partition

title: HDD emulator files: POPS.ELF + IOPRP252.IMG (decrypted)
text: HDD mode uses the DECRYPTED POPS files (not POPS_IOX.PAK), in __common/POPS. POPS.ELF MD5 355a892a8ce4e4a105469d4ef6f39a42 (the SLBB-00001 ELF). IOPRP252.IMG MD5 1db9c6020a2cd445a7bb176a1a3dd418 (from some retail discs / $CEI SDKs). Internal HDD mode. __common/POPS/POPS.ELF (MD5 355a892a...) ; __common/POPS/IOPRP252.IMG (MD5 1db9c602...) cei

title: Launch method 1: renamed-ELF-per-game
text: Each game has its own copy of POPSTARTER.ELF renamed to '<prefix><VCD name>.elf'. Prefix XX. (USB), SB. (SMB), or none/PP./__. (HDD per type). Launched via uLaunchELF, FMCB/FHDB, OPL Apps, etc. All storage types. XX.Crash Bandicoot.elf launches Crash Bandicoot.VCD

title: Launch method 2: single direct-VCD (uLE_kHn / OPL Apps)
text: Avoids per-game renaming. Place ONE un-renamed POPSTARTER.ELF in the POPS folder; a special uLaunchELF build (uLE_kHn, e.g. uLE_kHn_20191110) launches a .VCD directly like an ELF (put its BOOT at mc0:/BOOT). OPL's 'Apps' tab (conf_apps.cfg / APPS/<game>/<game>.elf) is the other common direct-launch UI. CORRECTS base report's 'wLE_kHn' typo -> 'uLE_kHn'. USB (uLE_kHn; 'SMB not supported ATM') + OPL Apps for USB/HDD/SMB. mass:/POPS/POPSTARTER.ELF + mass:/POPS/Crash Bandicoot.VCD + mc0:/BOOT/BOOT.ELF (uLE_kHn)

title: Launch method 3: modern POPSLoader fork (Lua/Enceladus)
text: POPSLoader is a Lua launcher on the Enceladus runtime bundling POPSLOADER.ELF + Lua scripts + textures + modules; drop .VCDs in a POPS folder plus your POPStarter ELF + POPS support files (IOPRP252.IMG, POPS.ELF, POPS.PAK, POPS_IOX.PAK), then run POPSLOADER.ELF. Boots from MC/MMCE/MX4SIO/USB(FAT32/exFAT); runs games from MMCE/MX4SIO/USB/APA-HDD. Originally by El_isra; current fork maintained by NathanNeurotic. Modern (post-POPStarter) fork; broad device support incl. MMCE/MX4SIO/exFAT not in stock POPStarter. POPS/POPSLOADER.ELF + POPS/<game>.VCD + POPS/POPS_IOX.PAK ; run POPSLOADER.ELF

title: VMCDIR.TXT
text: One-line text file in a game's VMC folder that redirects where POPS saves/reads the VMC pair (SLOT0.VMC + SLOT1.VMC); all other assets (TROJAN/PATCH/CHEATS) still load from the game folder. Forbidden chars / \ : . Not loaded if >103 bytes or >1 line. Target folder must stay inside the POPS folder. Per-game in the game folder; GLOBAL (one shared VMC pair for ALL games) when placed in the POPS root. USB/SMB/HDD. Must be copied into every POPS# folder. Save 'BLAHBLAH' as VMCDIR.TXT in mass:/POPS/MY_GAME/ -> POPS reads mass:/POPS/BLAHBLAH/SLOT0.VMC + SLOT1.VMC

title: VMCDIR.TXT (shared VMC grouping)
text: Multiple games point at one VMC folder so they share a single VMC pair (e.g. all FF8 discs, or a per-user save set). Put a VMCDIR.TXT naming the same destination folder into each game's folder. Per group of games. Also gives multiple users their own VMC folders for one library. smb:/Share/POPS/VMCDIR.TXT contains 'SAVES'; Crash/Tekken/Castlevania all save into smb:/Share/POPS/SAVES/SLOT0.VMC

title: SLOT0.VMC / SLOT1.VMC
text: The two virtual memory-card image files POPS auto-creates on first launch (POPS/<GameName>/SLOTx.VMC). SLOT0 = MC port 1, SLOT1 = port 2. PS1 retail saves imported via MemcardRex go into SLOT1.VMC. Standard PS1 MC images, MemcardRex-editable. Per game by default; on HDD inside __common/POPS/<vmcfolder>/. Number created (2/1/none) controlled by config offset $429 (NOT $42A). POPS/Crash Bandicoot.VCD -> POPS/Crash Bandicoot/SLOT0.VMC + SLOT1.VMC

title: HDD VMC location
text: On internal HDD, VMCs and per-game BIOS/OSD assets live in the __common partition under __common/POPS/<vmcfolder>/, decoupled from the VCD (which sits in its own __.POPS / PP. / __. partition). Internal HDD (hdd:) mode. __common/POPS/PBPX-95000.MY_GAME/SLOT0.VMC (VCD itself in __.POPS/MY_GAME.VCD)

title: POPS/VMC folder priority rule
text: Any external file (TROJAN/PATCH/BIOS.BIN/OSD.BIN/CHEATS.TXT/VMCDIR.TXT/DISCS.TXT) can live in the POPS folder (all games) or the game's VMC folder (that game). When the same type exists in both, the VMC-folder copy has priority. ONLY exception: two CHEATS.TXT loaded at once where one contains special cheats that change the video mode (special-cased). All POPStarter external assets, all backends. PATCH_5.BIN in POPS/ vs POPS/MY_GAME/ -> the MY_GAME copy wins for that game

title: Multi-folder POPS0..POPS9 (USB) asset-duplication caveat
text: Up to 11 game folders scanned at USB root (POPS, POPS0..POPS9). VMCDIR.TXT, BIOS.BIN, PATCH_#.BIN and TROJAN_#.BIN meant to be global must be COPIED into every POPS# folder (they don't propagate); POPS_IOX.PAK and the TM2 IGR-texture files must stay only in the MAIN POPS folder. USB mass: storage. HDD has __.POPS0..9 equivalent; SMB has only a single POPS folder. mass:/POPS0/Tekken.VCD + mass:/POPS0/VMCDIR.TXT copied from mass:/POPS/VMCDIR.TXT

title: DISCS.TXT
text: Multi-disc swap list. One VCD filename per line (WITH .VCD extension), up to 4 lines = disc 1..4. Enables in-game disc swapping without a PS1 reboot. Copy into the VMC/game folder of EVERY disc. Per multi-disc game. All VCDs must be in the same partition/folder. Feature present since OBT15. DISCS.TXT (in BOTH MGS_CD1/ and MGS_CD2/): MGS_CD1.VCD / MGS_CD2.VCD

title: Disc-swap hotkeys (lid + disc insert)
text: Hotkeys (since Beta 15, 2016-09-18): Select+L2+R2+Triangle = open lid; +Up = disc 1; +Right = disc 2; +Down = disc 3; +Left = disc 4; +Square = close lid. D-pad direction maps to the DISCS.TXT LINE number, not a physical disc label. In-game, multi-disc games with DISCS.TXT. OBT15+. Insert Disc 2: Select+L2+R2+Right ; Close lid: Select+L2+R2+Square

title: VMCDIR.TXT for multi-disc (single VMC pair)
text: Combine DISCS.TXT with a VMCDIR.TXT (naming disc 1's VMC folder) placed in every disc folder so all discs of one game share a single VMC pair - avoids manual VMC copy/paste between disc folders. Per multi-disc game. VMCDIR.TXT in disc 1 AND disc 2 (and any further disc) folders, naming the disc-1 folder. MGS/VMCDIR.TXT and MGS_2/VMCDIR.TXT both contain 'MGS' -> both discs save into POPS/MGS/SLOT0.VMC+SLOT1.VMC

title: HDD multi-disc (IMAGE0.VCD / IMAGE1.VCD)
text: On internal HDD, multi-disc games use IMAGE0.VCD / IMAGE1.VCD in the SAME PP. partition (POPStarter only looks for IMAGE0.VCD when booting HDD-OSD mode). The discs share one VMC, so no VMCDIR.TXT is needed. Internal HDD multi-disc. PP.<game> partition: IMAGE0.VCD + IMAGE1.VCD (shared VMC)

title: OSD.BIN over BIOS.BIN precedence
text: If an OSD replacement image named OSD.BIN exists in the VMC dir (or POPS folder) it is injected into POPS's built-in BIOS and used; when OSD.BIN is present, BIOS.BIN is IGNORED. BIOS.BIN alone lets you reach the MC manager / play CDDA tracks via the built-in shell. If neither exists, POPS uses its built-in BIOS. Using a BIOS/OSD does NOT improve game compatibility. Per-game (VMC/game folder) or global (POPS folder). HDD path e.g. __common/POPS/PBPX-95000.MY_GAME/OSD.BIN. POPS/MY_GAME/OSD.BIN present -> OSD.BIN used, POPS/MY_GAME/BIOS.BIN silently ignored

title: OSD.BIN header structure (v1)
text: Valid OSD replacement format. 0h-8h identifier 'PS-X OSD'; Ch = image version (non-NULL); Eh = OSD build (non-NULL); 1Ch-20h = OSD loadable segment size (header excluded); 20h-34h = OSD name (1-20 ASCII, 0x00-terminated). OSD load address and entrypoint must be multiples of 0x10000. Total file size = header length + OSD size. OSD.BIN files used with POPStarter (the BIOS-injection path). Bytes 0-7 = 'PS-X OSD'; name field at 0x20 = 'MY OSD\0'

title: USB-not-detected fix (offset $413 vs $USBDELAY)
text: If a USB drive/HDD isn't detected: hex-edit POPSTARTER.ELF offset $413 from 0x02 up toward 0x05/0x0A. Also verify FAT32 formatting, a defragmented device, and the POPS folder at the device ROOT. Debug the boot via DEBUG_AND_HALT.PPF or $410=non-zero. NOTE: $USBDELAY_# patches POPS (streaming) not POPStarter - it does NOT fix detection. r13 USB mode (older builds used $417). Offset $413: 0x02 -> 0x05 usbdelay usbdelay_

title: conf_elm.cfg cleanup (OPL Apps menu corruption)
text: If the OPL ELF-loader/Apps menu misbehaves after editing entries, delete conf_elm.cfg and conf_elms.cfg; conf_elmz.cfg is safe to keep. OPL regenerates the deleted files. OPL Apps-tab launching of POPStarter games. Delete conf_elm.cfg + conf_elms.cfg (keep conf_elmz.cfg)

title: Tomb Raider 1/2 CDDA desync (emulation limitation)
text: Tomb Raider 1/2 CDDA (Red Book) music desync/drift is a POPS emulation limitation, not a POPStarter misconfiguration - no CHEATS.TXT command reliably fixes it. Specific titles; documented as a known emulation limit. (known limitation - no fix)

title: Jackie Chan Stuntmaster (SCES-01444) - built-in LibCrypt crack
text: POPStarter has a built-in LibCrypt crack for Jackie Chan Stuntmaster (SCES-01444). If a particular disc batch lacks LibCrypt and still freezes, use $FAKELC or the explicit LibCrypt code block instead. Specific title. r13. SCES-01444 runs via the built-in crack; fall back to the LibCrypt example block fakelc

title: Tekken 3 - mode 0x06 + 0x04 combo
text: Tekken 3 is fixed by combining compatibility modes 0x06 and 0x04 - a concrete example that 0x06 and 0x04 combine safely (neither is in the exclusive 0x01/0x02/0x03/0x05 set). Specific title. r13. $COMPATIBILITY_0x06 + $COMPATIBILITY_0x04 compatibility_0x04 compatibility_0x06

title: Crash Bash PAL - best playable config
text: Community-documented best-playable configuration for Crash Bash PAL (a notoriously finicky title); pursue the per-title fix thread rather than a generic mode. Specific title. (see the title's fix thread)

title: POPStarter is the launcher/patch layer; POPS is Sony's emulator
text: POPStarter (krHACKen) is the launcher and patch/cheat layer wrapped AROUND Sony's PS1-on-PS2 POPS emulator (POPS.ELF / SLBB-00001). POPStarter loads per-game assets (CHEATS.TXT, PATCH/TROJAN, BIOS/OSD, VMCDIR/DISCS), applies the cheat engine and compatibility modes, and hands off to POPS to actually emulate. 'POPStarter' is a distinct project from the modern Lua-based POPSLoader fork. Whole architecture. Canonical package = 2019-06-05 r13 Beta. POPStarter.ELF reads CHEATS.TXT/PATCH_#.BIN, then launches POPS to emulate the VCD

title: Version timeline (key betas)
text: WIP01 = HDD __.POPS multi-VCD launch type. WIP02 (2014-08-22) = 8-slot force-compatibility table, IGR skin + IRX loaders default-on. Beta 8 (2015-10-23) = SMB/ps2host/napLink backends, PFS wrapper embedded. Beta 9 (2015-10-24) = mc1 module fallback. Beta 11 (2015-11-11) = SMB port selection, optional IPCONFIG.DAT, POPS# VCD-read fix. Beta 12 (2015-11-24) = $FORCEPAL, $SAFEMODE made functional, SMB auth, function-skipper cleanup begins. Beta 13 (2015-12-07) = BOOT.ELF exit chain, cheat-engine bug fixes ($C0/$USBDELAY/hook+8), function skipper REMOVED ($412 freed), ps2host/napLink launchers removed. Beta 15 (2016-09-18) = CD-lid/DISCS.TXT multi-disc, SetGsCrt(480p) calc. Beta 16 (2016-11-20) = $IGR0..5/$NOIGR/$D2LS integrated as CHEATS.TXT text, $412 repurposed as HDTVFIX, untested soft-reset hotkey. Prototype 2 (2017-05-27) = $42F test mode (0x04). r13 final (2019-06-05) = $IGR5 fixed. Historical reference. Canonical build = r13 2019-06-05. $IGR5 worked reliably only from the 2019-06-05 r13 final c0 d2ls forcepal igr0 igr5 noigr safemode usbdelay
